about: The argument a call says what it is for in, added to the parameters of every tool whose `purpose` is "purpose" (a tool may instead name a field of its own, as bash does with `description`, or have none). Shown to the user when they are asked to allow the call, and beside it in the transcript; the tool itself never sees it.
name: purpose

schema.description: One short sentence for the user: what this call is for — what you want to find out or get done. Shown when they are asked to allow it.
